newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India sells Aug Madras naphtha to Hanwha at -$19/T.
newsitem.headline: India sells Aug Madras naphtha to Hanwha at -$19/T.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has awarded a tender to sell 27,000-tonnes of low aromatic naphtha (LAN) from Madras in August to South Korea's Hanwha Chemical Corp at around $19 below Japanese spot quotes, on a free-on-board (fob) basis, industry sources said on Monday.
The tender which offered the August 6-8 lifting cargo from Madras on the east coast, closed July 24 and was valid for a day.
IOC's last LAN cargo from Madras, lifting July 6-8, was awarded at around $21.00 per tonne below Japanese naphtha spot quotes.
